name: Shiva Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Shiva Mills Ltd manufactures and markets Cotton Yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SML belongs to the Coimbatore-based Bannari Amman Group (BAG). It was formed to take over assets and liabilities of the Spinning Unit and certain windmills under the Scheme of Arrangement. Company exports ~30% of cotton yarn produced to far east countries

pros: Stock is trading at 0.59 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.61% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.19% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.41 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 45.6 to 58.0 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
